correctness.rationale: The proof is an exact contradiction from four displayed equations. Under \(I_c=I_{ck}=0\), \(S=0\) would give \(\dot S=\Lambda+\pi R>0\), hence \(S>0\). Then the \(I_c\)-equation and \(0\le\varepsilon_v\le1\) force \(H=0\); the \(H\)-equation and \(\zeta_k>0\) force \(I_k=0\); finally the \(I_k\)-equation gives the impossible equality \(0=\lambda_kS\). The special axes where a strict factor vanishes are excluded explicitly. Exact rational replay of the published baseline decimals also gives a positive residual at the displayed point.

originality.rationale: The final statement was compared at the level of implications, not titles. The primary source itself does not state the stronger no-equilibrium theorem; instead it labels a point with \(I_c=I_k=I_{ck}=H=0\) as a full-system disease-free equilibrium and proves threshold statements around it. Direct substitution shows that point is nonstationary for \(\lambda_k>0\), and the four-equation contradiction proves more strongly that no equilibrium with \(I_c=I_{ck}=0\) can exist under the printed positive-background assumptions. Targeted semantic searches returned no prior record covering this exact structural obstruction. The nearest COVID/CKD paper uses different infectious compartments, and the general next-generation reference only supplies the requirement of a genuine disease-free equilibrium.
residual_risks: A later correction could alter the printed hospital compartment or force of infection; the claim is explicitly about the version published 15 June 2026.

value.rationale: The gap affects the model's central invasion-threshold geometry rather than a cosmetic algebraic detail. With positive background CKD incidence, the printed COVID-free boundary does not contain any equilibrium, so a reproduction threshold and stability theorem based on the displayed point cannot describe elimination in the calibrated full model. The obstruction identifies the precise modeling mechanism—CKD-only flow into an aggregate hospital class that is counted as COVID-infectious—and points to the mathematically natural repair of splitting infectious from noninfectious hospitalization and linearizing about the actual CKD-background equilibrium.
